dimensions.name: single_source
dimensions.pass: One Canonical Handoff Contract remains authoritative.

dimensions.name: tier_calibration
dimensions.pass: Only execution guidance changes across tiers.

dimensions.name: feedback_completeness
dimensions.pass: All eight feedback types are supported and validated.

dimensions.name: resume_safety
dimensions.pass: Checkpoint and review bind continuation to a safe point.

dimensions.name: git_policy_control
dimensions.pass: Every Git side effect is explicitly authorized and reported.

dimensions.name: strict_type_enforcement
dimensions.pass: Validator rejects boolean, integer, array, enum, pattern, extra-field, and SHA violations.

dimensions.name: cross_artifact_consistency
dimensions.pass: Self-test verifies review_id, bundle/switch task identity, and reception-ack executor_id match.

dimensions.name: negative_test_coverage
dimensions.pass: Negative tests assert non-zero exit codes for type, enum, SHA, branch, and extra-field violations.

dimensions.name: artifact_readiness
dimensions.pass: Low-capability execution starts only after Chat freezes and tests final artifacts.

dimensions.name: strict_protocol_validation
dimensions.pass: All nested fields, enums, refs, SHAs, arrays, and extra fields are validated.

dimensions.name: manifest_integrity
dimensions.pass: Manifest file set and hashes match actual Skill files.
